summary: Iteration 15 — Verified the HRBP filter fix (_effective_depts helper) on the Performance page and other endpoints. Backend: 18/18 new tests + 22/22 previous regression tests pass (40/40 total). Frontend: Confirmed via network capture + screenshot on /admin/rapor/yapikredi/performance that (a) with NO filters, Departman Ort. Performansı chart shows all 10 departments and KPI high_performers=73; (b) with HRBP=Elif Aydın, chart narrows to exactly 2 departments (Kredi ve Risk, Hazine) and KPI high_performers=20 (matches spec ~20); (c) with HRBP=Zeynep Arslan, chart narrows to exactly 2 departments (Bireysel Bankacılık, Kurumsal Bankacılık); (d) Excel export button ('Excel'e Aktar') on top performers table still visible and functional. HRBP filter also narrows by_department on learning/compensation/career/engagement endpoints. Ek Kadro and Norm Kadro endpoints also accept hrbp param and narrow data. The reported bug 'performansta hrbp kriteri çalışmadı' is fixed.

integration_issues.issue: Changing the HRBP dropdown appears to reset the Department dropdown back to 'Tüm Departmanlar' in the frontend, so the request only carries hrbp=... (dept param is dropped). This prevents users from selecting a Dept + HRBP intersection from the UI, even though the backend correctly supports it (verified via direct API call: department=Hazine&hrbp=Elif%20Aydın returns exactly 1 department). Not a blocker for the reported bug, but limits UX. Reproduced: select Dept=Hazine → chart shows 1 dept → then select HRBP=Elif Aydın → chart shows 2 depts (Elif's list) with Department selector reverted to Tüm Departmanlar.

test_results.backend_pytest: 40/40 pass (18 new HRBP-narrowing tests + 22 previous regression). Reports: /app/test_reports/pytest/iter15_hrbp.xml

frontend_playwright_performance_page.top_performers_table_narrows: After HRBP=Elif, table only lists Kredi ve Risk / Hazine employees  ✅

action_items: OPTIONAL/UX: Investigate whether the Department selector should be preserved when HRBP is changed. Currently it resets to 'Tüm Departmanlar', which blocks users from combining Dept + HRBP filters from the UI. Backend supports the intersection correctly; only the frontend filter-state coupling needs review (likely in DashboardRoutes or the filter context provider).

OPTIONAL: When Dept and HRBP are mutually exclusive (e.g., Hazine + Zeynep Arslan → empty intersection), the API returns 200 with by_department=[] and high_performers=0. Consider showing a UI hint 'Seçilen departman bu HRBP'nin sorumluluk alanında değil' instead of an empty chart.
critical_code_review_comments: _effective_depts() correctly composes segment + department + hrbp filters — clean, single-responsibility helper. Applied consistently to all 11 department-iteration loops.

run_scenario endpoint was intentionally left with the old pattern (per E1's note). Verify manually if scenario simulations need HRBP filtering too; if yes, add dept/hrbp params to that endpoint as well.

Frontend: DashboardRoutes still remounts children on any filter change (see iter14 note). When HRBP changes, this likely also clears the local dept state — the observed 'Department resets on HRBP change' UX issue may be a side-effect of the remount, not intentional coupling.
server.py is now 3937 lines — approaching monolith territory. Consider splitting dashboard endpoints into /app/backend/routes/dashboard_*.py modules.
test_credentials: admin@plenalitik.com / Plena2025!  (works). Tenant: yapikredi. Data-testids: hrbp-selector, department-selector, segment-selector, year-selector.
seed_data_creation: None needed — yapikredi tenant already re-seeded in iter14 with hrbp field on employees.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_hrbp_department_narrowing.py is the regression suite for _effective_depts(). Depends on yapikredi being seeded with employees carrying the hrbp field (done in iter14). If any test suddenly returns 0 headcount for an HRBP, re-run POST /api/tenants/{id}/seed. Known frontend behaviour: changing HRBP resets Department to 'Tüm Departmanlar' — this is either intentional or a remount side-effect from DashboardRoutes key. Backend supports the Dept+HRBP intersection correctly (verified by direct API call).
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 'performansta hrbp kriteri çalışmadı': The Performance endpoint's by_department loop iterated over `seg_depts or cfg['DEPARTMENTS']` — which resolves to ALL 10 departments when only HRBP is selected (seg_depts is derived from segment filter, ignoring HRBP). Result: users saw all 10 departments in the chart with 8 of them at score=0 (no employees matched), making the filter appear broken. Fix (verified): _effective_depts(sector, segment, department, hrbp) now composes all three filters and returns exactly the relevant department subset. Applied to 11 dashboard endpoints. Verified end-to-end: HRBP=Elif Aydın now produces exactly 2 department bars in Departman Ort. Performansı chart and KPI high_performers drops from 73 → 20.
